integrity: All claimed finite polynomial identities are reproducible by the included self-contained standard-library script. Mathematical review is self-review, not an independent audit.
limitations: Marked geometric parameters over an algebraic closure, not distinct isomorphism classes. Only genus-three Cartier rank, p-rank and a-number are classified; no full nonordinary Newton polygons. Priority against unindexed historical computational tables remains uncertain.
title: Cartier-rank stratification and the first extra superspecial fibers of a cyclic-six genus-three family
